summary: Careful, artifact-backed preregistered paired trial. Methods, preregistration, execution, analysis, and disclosure are well documented and archived. The study reports a numerically negligible, non-significant marginal benefit from a one-repair guarded pipeline due to a ceiling baseline; authors transparently acknowledge power invalidation and discuss implications.
optional_revisions: Condense the in-manuscript Disclosure Statement to a shorter paragraph that preserves all mandatory facts and points readers to the archived provenance bundle for detailed logs and hashes (as suggested in the prior review).

Add a single-line boxed mapping or tiny table in Methods showing preregistration labels A/B/C → executed contrast under shared_initial_candidate semantics to make the arm-to-execution mapping immediately clear to unfamiliar readers.

Optionally state, in one short sentence, that the single discordant pair corresponds to pair-000069 and that its validator/repair traces are archived (cite the manifest) to help auditors locate the representative failure without embedding low-level paths or hashes in the paper.
